response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM (SELECT MediaType.Name, AVG(CAST(Track.Bytes as DECIMAL) / Track.Milliseconds) as avg_ratio FROM Track INNER JOIN MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId WHERE Track.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaType.MediaTypeId, MediaType.Name) subquery

assumptions.assumption: Interpreted 'pass a file-size cutoff of 10,323,804 bytes' as Bytes > 10,323,804 (strictly exceeding the cutoff)

alternatives.interpretation: Could interpret 'pass a file-size cutoff' as Bytes >= 10,323,804, including files that are exactly 10,323,804 bytes
